verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly requests a short leadership-focused pre-interview checklist, establishing the manuscript artifact, audience, content, and scope.
The client changes the chapter-length acceptance guidance and requires country-specific checklist content, including USA–India differences.
The client explicitly accepts the immediately preceding proposed manuscript wording covering the chapter-length treatment and inclusion of UK and UAE perspectives.
The client explicitly defines the deliverable as a non-question-and-answer basic chapter and narrows its length acceptance condition to 4,000–6,000 words or shorter.
The client rejects the submitted work and explicitly ends the project, removing the outstanding chapter requirement.
